mechanism: Both agents affect dopaminergic and circadian pathways; pramipexole is a dopamine agonist while melatonin modulates circadian rhythm and may have dopaminergic effects, potentially leading to additive CNS effects and sleep-wake cycle disturbances.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and impulse control issues; melatonin may be used cautiously as adjunctive sleep aid but requires patient education on combined CNS effects and potential synergistic hypotension.
